exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 A Smart Speaker at Home
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Lin: We just got a smart speaker for the living room.
Sam: Really? What can it actually do?
Lin: I can ask it to play music, check the weather, or turn off the lights.
Sam: That sounds useful. Does it understand you easily?
Lin: Most of the time. It even learns which songs I like.
Sam: Aren't you worried that it is always listening?
Lin: A little, so I switch it off when we have guests.
Sam: That's sensible. I might get one for my kitchen.
exercises.translation_cn: 林家客厅新添了一个智能音箱;Sam 问它能做什么;林说能放音乐、查天气、关灯;它大多时候听得懂,还学会了她喜欢的歌;Sam 问是否担心它一直在听;林说有点,所以来客人时会关掉;Sam 觉得明智,想给自己厨房也买一个。

questions.stem: Where did Lin put the smart speaker?
What can Lin ask the speaker to do?
options: Play music and turn off the lights.

questions.stem: What does the speaker learn over time?
Why does Lin switch it off sometimes?
options: She worries about privacy when guests come.
Because it is far too loud.

questions.stem: What does Sam decide at the end?
options: He wants to sell his own.
He may get one for his kitchen.
He will give Lin some money.

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 An AI Study App
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Many students now use an AI app to help them learn.
The app gives each learner exercises at the right level.
If you make a mistake, it explains the rule in a simple way.
It also remembers the words you find hard and tests them again.
Used well, such an app can make study faster and more fun.
exercises.translation_cn: 如今许多学生用 AI 软件帮助学习;软件给每位学习者难度合适的练习;若答错,它会简单地讲解规则;它还会记住你觉得难的单词,再次考你;用得好,这样的软件能让学习更快、更有趣。

questions.stem: Who uses the AI app?
What does the app give each learner?
What happens if you make a mistake?
options: It explains the rule in a simple way.

questions.stem: Which words does the app test again?
options: The words you already know well.

questions.stem: What is the main message of the passage?
options: A good AI app can make study easier.

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Is AI a Threat?
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Mia: Did you read that AI could be either the best or the worst thing for us?
Tom: Yes, a famous scientist said that. It really made me think.
Mia: I feel AI is mostly good. It can solve problems that are too hard for people.
Tom: True, but what if a machine becomes too powerful one day?
Mia: Then we need clear rules to keep it under control.
Tom: I agree. The danger is not the tool itself but how we use it.
Mia: Exactly. We should welcome AI, yet stay careful.
Tom: Well said. Fear alone will not help us.
exercises.translation_cn: Mia 问 Tom 是否读到 AI 可能是对人类最好或最坏的东西;Tom 说一位著名科学家这么讲,引人深思;Mia 觉得 AI 大体是好的,能解决人类难以应对的问题;Tom 担心机器有朝一日变得太强大;Mia 说那就需要明确规则加以控制;Tom 同意,危险不在工具本身,而在我们如何使用;两人一致认为既要欢迎 AI,又要保持谨慎;光靠恐惧无济于事。

questions.stem: What did the famous scientist say about AI?
options: It could be either the best or the worst thing.
It will never change at all.
It is only a simple game.

questions.stem: Why does Mia think AI is mostly good?
options: It can solve very hard problems.

questions.stem: What worries Tom?
What does Mia say we need?
options: Clear rules to keep AI under control.

questions.stem: What do they finally agree on?

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 AI on the Farm
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Artificial intelligence is now helping farmers grow food.
Small flying machines can check the fields and find weak plants.
Smart systems decide exactly when the crops need water.
This saves water and helps farmers harvest more.
Thanks to such tools, less food is wasted each year.
exercises.translation_cn: 人工智能如今正帮助农民种植粮食;小型飞行器能巡查农田、找出长势弱的作物;智能系统精确决定庄稼何时需要浇水;这样既节水又帮农民提高收成;有了这些工具,每年浪费的粮食更少了。

questions.stem: Who is AI helping in this passage?
What can the small flying machines do?
options: Check fields and find weak plants.

questions.stem: What do the smart systems decide?
What is one result of using these tools?
What happens to food waste?
options: Less food is wasted each year.

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Could You Be Friends with a Robot?
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Anna: If a robot pet acted just like a real dog, could you love it?
Ben: Maybe. A boy in a story I read truly loved his robot dog.
Anna: But a robot only pretends to love you. It is just a machine.
Ben: How can we be sure? We never really know what is inside.
Anna: That's a fair point. Still, a real animal is alive.
Ben: For the boy, what mattered was how he felt about it.
Anna: So friendship might be more about feelings than about metal.
Ben: Right. Perhaps the heart decides, not the wires.
exercises.translation_cn: Anna 问 Ben:如果机器宠物表现得跟真狗一模一样,你能爱它吗;Ben 说也许吧,他读过的故事里有个男孩真心爱他的机器狗;Anna 说机器只是假装爱你,它不过是台机器;Ben 说我们怎能确定,谁也不真正知道里面是什么;Anna 承认有理,但真正的动物是活的;Ben 说对那男孩而言,重要的是他对它的感受;两人觉得友谊也许更多关乎感情而非金属;或许做决定的是心,而不是电线。

questions.stem: What does Anna ask at the start?
options: Where to buy a real dog.
How to fix a broken phone.

questions.stem: What did the boy in the story do?
options: He truly loved his robot dog.

questions.stem: Why does Anna doubt a robot's love?
options: She thinks it only pretends and is just a machine.
She says it costs too much.

questions.stem: What does Ben say we can never be sure of?
options: What is really inside another being.

questions.stem: What do they decide friendship may depend on?

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 AI All Around Us
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: These days, artificial intelligence is hidden in many everyday things.
It suggests films we might like and answers our spoken questions.
Most of the time, we hardly notice that it is even there.
AI is not magic, and it is not something to fear.
If we use it wisely, it can quietly make life better.
exercises.translation_cn: 如今人工智能藏在许多日常事物里;它会推荐我们可能喜欢的电影,回答我们口头的问题;大多数时候,我们几乎察觉不到它的存在;AI 不是魔法,也不是用来害怕的东西;只要善加利用,它能悄悄让生活变得更好。
